areal-precip: One map of a synthetic 60 by 60 kilometre storm field over a made-up nine-sided basin, drawn in viridis colours: low values (about 7 millimetres, purple) on the west side rising eastward, with one bright storm cell of about 45 millimetres near the centre. Six gauge sites G1 to G6 are white dots, each with a white label giving its Thiessen weight, and dashed white lines mark the boundaries of the six Thiessen regions. Weights: G4 is the largest at 0.26, then G3 0.18, G5 0.17, G6 0.17, G1 0.12 and G2 0.11.
precip-climate: Two panels for the Leaf River near Collins, Mississippi. Left: bar chart of mean monthly precipitation for October to September over water years 1990 to 2009, between about 90 millimetres in October and a peak of about 163 millimetres in January; the December to February bars are hatched with diagonal lines and the June to August bars are dotted, at about 117, 124 and 121 millimetres. Right: a log-log exceedance curve of daily precipitation on wet days, running from the largest day of about 70 millimetres at the left down to 1 millimetre where about 26 percent of all days exceed it, with a dashed horizontal line at the high-precipitation threshold of five times the mean (about 19 millimetres) and a dotted line at 1 millimetre.
